title: Austin: Gas Station Proposed, Garage Approved
summary:
*   A proposal was submitted to install a new gasoline station at 29th and Guadalupe Streets, which was placed under review.
*   An application to build a galvanized iron shed at 200 Brazos Street was referred to the Safety Committee for consideration.
*   Following a special meeting, the application for an "iron garage" at 200 Brazos Street (likely the previously mentioned shed) received official approval.

REGULAR MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas, December 1,1922.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor, Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and
Searight, 5; absent, none.
The Minutes of the last meeting were read and upon motion of Councilman Copeland were
adopted by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and
Searight, 5; nayes, none.
The application of Mrs. Ernest H. Odiorne to erect a galvanized iron shed at 200 Brazos
Street was read and upon motion of Councilman Searight was referred to the Safety
Committee by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and
Searight, 5; nayes, none.
The Council then recessed,
:
SPECIAL MEETING OF THE CITY COUNCIL:
Austin, Texas, December 5, 1922,
The Council was called to order by the Mayor, Roll call showed the following members
present: Mayor Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyres, Haynes and
Searight, 5; absent, none,
Upon recommendation of the Safety Committee, the application of Mrs. Ernest H. Odiorne to
erect an iron garage at 200 Brazos Street was granted by the following vote: Ayes, Mayor
Yett, Councilmen Copeland, Eyrea, Haynes and Searight, 5; nayes, none.
The Council then adjourned,
